svg.title: Fine-tune or not: walk the tree, do not argue
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Fine-tune or not: walk the tree, do not argue” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn decision tree. The root asks whether the model is missing facts or missing behaviour. The facts branch runs left through putting it in the prompt and then RAG to a green terminal costing two days and $0.0006 a query, with the branch from facts to fine-tuning crossed out in red and two bars beneath showing 31 percent recall from fine-tuning against 94 percent from putting the same facts in the prompt. The behaviour branch runs right through better prompts, five-shot examples and a hundred-item eval before reaching fine-tuning, beside memory bars of 132.6, 21.3 and 14.2 GB for full fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA against a dashed 24 GB A10G line.
svg.text: Fine-tune or not: walk the tree, do not argue
draw it from memory, then compare
